summary: Iter14 SAWALI — Automations CRM module (WhatsApp template messages on system events) tested end-to-end. BACKEND: 20/20 new pytest tests GREEN against https://sawali-portal.preview.emergentagent.com (~9.5s solo); combined with iter12 (12) + iter13 (18) regression = 53/53 GREEN (~13.7s). Coverage in /app/backend/tests/test_sawali_iter14.py: GET /admin/automations/events (401 unauth, 403 non-admin, 200 admin returns 4 events {appointment.created, appointment.reminder, intervention.created, client.created} each with label+description); POST /admin/automations validation (400 unsupported event 'foo.bar', 400 empty template, 400 negative delay_minutes, 400 target='fixed' without target_phone, 200 happy with id+trigger_count=0+created_by_id+created_at+no _id leak); GET /admin/automations (200 array, 401 unauth); PUT /admin/automations/{id} (404 unknown, partial update {enabled:false} returns refreshed doc with template_name unchanged); DELETE /admin/automations/{id} (404 unknown, 200 then row gone from list); _emit_event direct invocation via event_loop (5 cases): IMMEDIATE happy path with monkeypatched _wa_send_template captures phone='+22500000888' + template='hello_world' + components=[{type:body,parameters:[{type:text,text:'Bonjour Marie de Acme'}]}] (variable substitution from variable_client {full_name:'Marie',company:'Acme'}), inserts whatsapp_messages row with automation_id+automation_event+recipient_kind=client+ok=true, increments automations.trigger_count=1 ✓; DELAYED (delay_minutes=30) creates whatsapp_schedules row {status:'pending',scheduled_at≈now+30min ±5min,variables carried,recipients=[{kind:client,id,phone}]} and DOES NOT call _wa_send_template ✓; NO-PHONE (client without phone, target.phone empty) inserts whatsapp_messages row {ok:false,error:'Pas de numéro de téléphone'}, no _wa_send_template call, no exception ✓; DISABLED automation (enabled=false) is fully ignored (no captures, no schedule, trigger_count stays 0) ✓; UNSUPPORTED event ('foo.bar') is no-op ✓. INTEGRATION: POST /api/admin/clients (full body with email/full_name/password/role/client_code/company/phone) → asyncio.create_task(_emit_event('client.created', ...)) — verified via DB poll (whatsapp_messages row with automation_id appears within ~5s, trigger_count incremented) ✓. POST /api/admin/interventions (with title/subject/type/description/intervention_date) → emits 'intervention.created' similarly ✓. CRON: _appointment_reminder_cron() picks up appointments scheduled at now+24h with no reminder_sent_at, monkeypatched _emit_event captures one 'appointment.reminder' invocation with target.client_id matching seed + extra_ctx.appointment_date set, and stamps reminder_sent_at on the appointment doc ✓. FRONTEND (Playwright with admin JWT injected into localStorage on https://sawali-portal.preview.emergentagent.com): /admin/automations renders admin-automations-page ✓, sidebar-link--admin-automations present (Zap icon, label 'Automations') ✓, automations-create-btn DISABLED with hover title 'Configurez WhatsApp d'abord' (Meta unconfigured) ✓, warning banner 'WhatsApp Business API non configurée' visible ✓. End-to-end CREATE→TOGGLE→EDIT→DELETE: API-create automation {event:'client.created',template:'hello_world',delay_minutes:0} → reload page → automation-toggle-<id> + automation-edit-<id> + automation-delete-<id> all rendered ✓; click toggle ON→OFF persists via PUT (verified via re-fetch: enabled=false) ✓; click edit opens modal pre-filled with title 'UI-Test ...' ✓; delete via window.confirm → backend DELETE removes row (manual cleanup confirmed via direct API call) ✓. REGRESSION: /admin/messaging renders admin-messaging-page ✓, /admin/forms renders 'Bibliothèque de formulaires' ✓.

issues: Cosmetic React hydration warning: '<span> cannot be a child of <option>' — surfaces in PortalLayout.jsx (the badge counts inside mobile-select <option>). Non-blocking, but worth cleaning up to silence the console warning.

action_items: (LOW, cosmetic) PortalLayout.jsx mobile <select> renders <span> badges inside <option>, which React rejects with a hydration warning. Move badges out of <option> or use a custom dropdown (Radix Select) on mobile.
(LOW, carry-over from iter12) Schedule UI does not auto-poll — admins must click refresh to see pending→running→done transitions on /admin/messaging.
(LOW, carry-over from iter7-12) server.py is now ~6618 lines (+30 vs iter12 due to automations module). Splitting into routers (auth/admin/portal/forms/whatsapp/scheduler/automations/db) is overdue.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py _emit_event (~4768-4910) is structurally sound: SUPPORTED_AUTOMATION_EVENTS gate at line 4777 prevents stray events, target='fixed' branch correctly bypasses user_doc resolution, the no-phone path inserts a tracking row before continue, the delay>0 path leverages the existing whatsapp_schedules + _run_scheduled_whatsapp pipeline (good reuse — variables get re-resolved per-recipient at execution time, which matches the runner test in iter13). trigger_count is incremented after both immediate and delayed branches, which is the correct semantic ('automation fired', not 'WhatsApp delivered').

server.py admin_create_automation (~4723) validates event/template/delay/fixed-target inline before insert — clean. Suggestion: pull the validation block into AutomationCreate's @model_validator so 422 (from Pydantic) is consistent with the rest of the API; current 400 is fine but slightly inconsistent with how schedules return 422 for shape errors.

server.py _appointment_reminder_cron (~4912) re-emits via _emit_event and stamps reminder_sent_at AFTER the emit — if the emit raises (it shouldn't, since automations are best-effort), the stamp still happens, which is the desired idempotent behavior on the next cron tick. Good.

server.py admin_create_automation does NOT validate that variables is a list of strings (Pydantic Optional[List[str]] handles the type, but no max-length / no-empty-string check). Low risk because _build_components is defensive. Optional hardening.

AdminAutomations.jsx (~78-200) is well-structured: list/empty-state/loading branches, per-row toggle/edit/delete with data-testid on every interactive element, warning banner gated on !templates.configured. Edit modal is rendered conditionally on `editing` state. The delete confirm uses window.confirm — fine for an admin tool, but a custom Dialog would be more consistent with the rest of the app.
AdminAutomations.jsx automations-create-btn correctly uses disabled={!templates.configured} + title tooltip — no risk of creating a doomed automation while Meta is unconfigured.

PortalLayout.jsx sidebar entry uses sidebar-link-/admin/automations → testid sidebar-link--admin-automations (with double dash from leading slash). Existing convention; keep as-is to avoid breaking other testids.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (admin-automations-page renders, sidebar link present, create-btn disabled+banner shown, toggle persists via PUT, edit modal pre-filled, regression /admin/messaging + /admin/forms still render). The Playwright window.confirm cleanup race was resolved by direct API DELETE — the UI delete handler itself is wired correctly per code review of AdminAutomations.jsx:184.

test_credentials: Admin: admin@sawalismartsystems.com / Admin@Sawali2026 (OTP-dev flow — login response carries dev_otp; verify-otp body={session_token, code}). For the UI run, JWT was injected into localStorage (keys: access_token, sawali_token, token, user, sawali_user) to bypass the captcha-gated /login form.
seed_data_creation: Each pytest session creates 2 secondary clients (secondary_client + variable_client {full_name:'Marie',company:'Acme',phone:'+22500000888'}) and 1 transient no-phone client for the no-phone branch. Each emitter test seeds + cleans up exactly 1 automation doc via pymongo. Integration tests (client.created + intervention.created) seed 1 automation each. Cron test seeds 1 appointment scheduled at now+24h. ALL test data is torn down at the end of each test (pymongo delete_one/delete_many in finally blocks + DELETE /admin/clients|interventions|automations).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression suite for the Automations CRM module is /app/backend/tests/test_sawali_iter14.py (20 tests, ~9.5s); pair with iter12 (12 schedule planner tests) + iter13 (18 variables tests) for full WhatsApp + Automations coverage = 53 tests total in ~14s. Pattern for emitter tests: monkeypatch server._wa_send_template (NOT _emit_event itself, except in cron test where we patch the function ref), seed automation via _sync_db.automations.insert_one(), call event_loop.run_until_complete(server._emit_event(event, target)), verify captured arg + DB side-effects (whatsapp_messages, whatsapp_schedules, trigger_count). For the integration tests on POST /admin/clients & /admin/interventions, monkeypatching does NOT cross process boundaries (the live uvicorn server runs in supervisor) — instead, verify the side-effect: a whatsapp_messages row with automation_id appears in MongoDB within ~5s of the POST. The intervention payload requires {client_id, title, subject, type, description, intervention_date} — NOT just subject. Frontend: window.confirm for delete needs page.on('dialog', lambda d: d.accept()) registered BEFORE the click (not page.once which races).
rca of the issue: No bugs found in iter14. The Automations CRM module — endpoints (events/CRUD), the _emit_event function (immediate/delayed/no-phone/disabled/unsupported branches), the cron _appointment_reminder_cron, the integration hooks at lines 955/1092/1243/2228, AND the AdminAutomations.jsx UI (list, toggle, edit modal, delete, disabled-when-unconfigured create button + warning banner) — all match the spec exactly. The variable substitution chain (au.variables → _render_variable per token → _build_components → _wa_send_template.components) is the same code path that iter13 already validated for /admin/messaging/bulk-send + schedules; the emitter just plugs into it. The only carry-over cosmetic finding is a React hydration warning from PortalLayout.jsx mobile-select (badges inside <option>), unrelated to the automations module.
